title: New Technology
subtitle: 現代創新；現代的新發明／新方法
description: 現代創新；現代的新發明／新方法

words.meaning: 現代創新；現代的新發明／新方法
words.note: 當 new technology 強調當代出現的新產品、系統或創新成果，而不是單一技術本身時，可用 modern innovations。它常以複數形式出現。
words.example: Modern innovations have changed the way people work.
words.exampleZh: 現代創新改變了人們工作的方式。

exercises.original: New technology such as smart sensors, digital payments, and automated checkouts is changing everyday shopping.
exercises.zh: 智能感應器、電子支付和自動結帳等新科技正在改變日常購物。
exercises.upgrade: modern innovations · 現代創新；現代的新發明／新方法

options.explanation: modern innovations = 現代創新。句子列出多項當代創新成果，因此改成複數主語最自然。
emerging technology = 新興科技。通常強調仍在快速發展、尚未完全成熟的技術；電子支付和自助結帳已相當普及。
cutting-edge technology = 尖端科技。語氣更強，暗示處於技術最前沿；題目只是列舉現代創新。
advanced technology = 先進科技。強調技術水平高，不一定表示最近出現。
legacy systems = 舊式系統。和 new technology 方向相反。
traditional methods = 傳統方法。也和現代創新相反。

exercises.original: Museums are using new technology such as interactive displays and augmented-reality guides to engage visitors.
exercises.zh: 博物館利用互動顯示器和擴增實境導覽等現代創新來吸引訪客。
exercises.upgrade: modern innovations · 現代創新；現代的新發明／新方法

options.explanation: recent technological advances = 近期科技進步。可泛指近年的進展，但這句列舉的是具體創新產品與應用。
modern innovations = 現代創新。interactive displays 和 AR guides 是多項具體創新成果。
next-generation technology = 下一代技術。通常指正在取代現有一代的全新技術，不必然適合已廣泛採用的博物館工具。
advanced machinery = 先進機械。AR 導覽並不是 machinery。
old equipment = 舊設備。和題意相反。
manual techniques = 人工作法。和數碼創新相反。

exercises.original: The exhibition shows how new technology has transformed homes over the last twenty years.
exercises.zh: 展覽展示現代創新在過去二十年如何改變家庭生活。
exercises.upgrade: modern innovations · 現代創新；現代的新發明／新方法

options.explanation: modern innovations = 現代創新。over the last twenty years + transformed homes 適合概括一系列當代創新。
obsolete technology = 過時科技。和 transformed homes through new technology 的方向不同。
traditional tools = 傳統工具。不是現代科技。
manual systems = 人工系統。與新技術相反。
legacy equipment = 舊式設備。不是題目重點。
old-fashioned methods = 舊式方法。相反。

words.meaning: 近期科技進展；近年的技術進步
words.note: 當 new technology 強調近年取得的技術進步，而不只是某一件新產品時，可用 recent technological advances。適合研究、新聞和正式說明。
words.example: Recent technological advances have improved medical imaging.
words.exampleZh: 近期科技進展改善了醫學影像技術。

exercises.original: New technology has made solar panels cheaper and more efficient over the past five years.
exercises.zh: 過去五年，近期科技進展令太陽能板更便宜、更高效。
exercises.upgrade: recent technological advances · 近期科技進展；近年的技術進步

options.explanation: recent technological advances = 近期科技進展。over the past five years + cheaper and more efficient 清楚表示近年的持續技術進步。
modern innovations = 現代創新。也接近，但這句重點是效率和成本改善的進展。
emerging technology = 新興科技。太陽能板本身並非新興領域。
cutting-edge technology = 尖端科技。會暗示最前沿水平，題目只說近年有進步。
obsolete systems = 過時系統。相反。
traditional engineering = 傳統工程。不能表達近年技術改善。

exercises.original: Doctors can now detect smaller tumors because of new technology developed in medical imaging.
exercises.zh: 由於醫學影像方面近期的科技進展，醫生現在能偵測更小的腫瘤。
exercises.upgrade: recent technological advances · 近期科技進展；近年的技術進步

options.explanation: advanced technology = 先進科技。意思可通，但 cannot detect before → can now detect 更突出技術進步。
recent technological advances = 近期科技進展。can now + developed in medical imaging 是典型科技進步語境。
modern gadgets = 現代小型裝置。醫學影像設備不適合叫 gadgets。
next-generation devices = 下一代裝置。題目沒有明確代際更新。
traditional methods = 傳統方法。相反。
legacy systems = 舊式系統。相反。

exercises.original: New technology in battery chemistry has increased how far electric cars can travel on one charge.
exercises.zh: 電池化學方面近期的科技進展提高了電動車一次充電的續航距離。
exercises.upgrade: recent technological advances · 近期科技進展；近年的技術進步

options.explanation: recent technological advances = 近期科技進展。battery chemistry + increased range 描述的是技術性能的進步。
obsolete techniques = 過時技術。方向相反。
manual methods = 人工作法。無關。
legacy technology = 舊技術。相反。
traditional engineering only = 只靠傳統工程。不能表達新進展。
old systems = 舊系統。相反。

words.meaning: 新興科技；正在發展中的技術
words.note: 當 new technology 指正在快速發展、仍未完全成熟或尚未全面普及的技術時，可用 emerging technology。
words.example: The conference focuses on emerging technology such as quantum computing.
words.exampleZh: 這個會議聚焦量子運算等新興科技。

exercises.original: The university created a research center for new technology that is still developing, including quantum computing and advanced robotics.
exercises.zh: 大學成立研究中心，研究仍在發展中的新興科技，包括量子運算和先進機械人技術。
exercises.upgrade: emerging technology · 新興科技；正在發展中的技術

options.explanation: emerging technology = 新興科技。still developing 是決定性線索，表示技術尚未完全成熟。
latest technology = 最新科技。只表示最新，不一定仍在形成或發展。
modern innovations = 現代創新。範圍較廣。
legacy technology = 舊式科技。相反。
conventional equipment = 傳統設備。相反。
traditional systems = 傳統系統。相反。

exercises.original: Investors are watching new technology that could become commercially important within the next decade.
exercises.zh: 投資者正留意可能在未來十年變得具商業重要性的新興科技。
exercises.upgrade: emerging technology · 新興科技；正在發展中的技術

options.explanation: cutting-edge technology = 尖端科技。可能是最前沿，但不一定仍未商業成熟。
emerging technology = 新興科技。could become commercially important within the next decade 明確表示仍在成長階段。
advanced technology = 先進科技。只表示水平高。
latest technology = 最新科技。只表示新近推出。
obsolete technology = 過時科技。相反。
traditional technology = 傳統科技。相反。

exercises.original: Regulators are trying to understand new technology before it becomes widely used by the public.
exercises.zh: 監管機構正嘗試在新興科技廣泛普及前了解它。
exercises.upgrade: emerging technology · 新興科技；正在發展中的技術

options.explanation: emerging technology = 新興科技。before it becomes widely used 明確表示仍未普及。
legacy systems = 舊式系統。相反。
traditional methods = 傳統方法。相反。
obsolete equipment = 過時設備。無關。
mature technology = 成熟技術。和尚未廣泛普及的語境相反。
old infrastructure = 舊基建。無關。

words.note: 當 new technology 強調目前處於技術最前沿、代表最高水平或最新突破時，可用 cutting-edge technology。語氣比 new technology 強。
words.example: The laboratory uses cutting-edge technology to analyze DNA.
words.exampleZh: 實驗室使用尖端科技分析 DNA。

exercises.original: The laboratory uses new technology capable of measuring changes that older instruments cannot detect.
exercises.zh: 實驗室使用尖端科技，可以測量舊儀器無法偵測的變化。
exercises.upgrade: cutting-edge technology · 尖端科技；最前沿科技

options.explanation: cutting-edge technology = 尖端科技。older instruments cannot detect 表示性能處於技術前沿。
modern innovations = 現代創新。太廣，不能突出最高技術水平。
emerging technology = 新興科技。新興不一定性能最先進。
basic technology = 基礎技術。與題目相反。
legacy equipment = 舊設備。相反。
traditional methods = 傳統方法。相反。

exercises.original: The hospital invested in new technology that is currently among the most advanced in the world.
exercises.zh: 醫院投資了目前屬全球最先進水平的尖端科技。
exercises.upgrade: cutting-edge technology · 尖端科技；最前沿科技

options.explanation: advanced technology = 先進科技。也可，但 among the most advanced in the world 更直接支持 cutting-edge。
cutting-edge technology = 尖端科技。最先進水平是最典型線索。
latest consumer technology = 最新消費科技。醫院設備不是消費產品。
modern innovation = 現代創新。力度不足。
legacy system = 舊式系統。相反。
conventional equipment = 傳統設備。相反。

exercises.original: The chip manufacturer is using new technology at the absolute limit of current semiconductor design.
exercises.zh: 晶片製造商使用處於當前半導體設計極限的尖端科技。
exercises.upgrade: cutting-edge technology · 尖端科技；最前沿科技

options.explanation: cutting-edge technology = 尖端科技。at the absolute limit of current design 是非常強的前沿線索。
mature technology = 成熟技術。可以可靠但不一定最前沿。
traditional technology = 傳統科技。相反。
legacy technology = 舊式科技。相反。
basic equipment = 基礎設備。相反。
conventional systems = 傳統系統。相反。

words.note: 當 new technology 只強調『目前最新推出／最新一代』，而不一定表示重大突破時，可用 latest technology。
words.example: The store demonstrates the latest technology in home automation.
words.exampleZh: 這間店展示家居自動化方面的最新科技。

exercises.original: The exhibition lets visitors try new technology released by major electronics companies this year.
exercises.zh: 展覽讓訪客試用各大電子公司今年推出的最新科技。
exercises.upgrade: latest technology · 最新科技；最新技術

options.explanation: latest technology = 最新科技。released ... this year 是最明確的新近推出線索。
emerging technology = 新興科技。可能尚未正式上市。
cutting-edge technology = 尖端科技。最新不一定等於最前沿。
legacy technology = 舊技術。相反。
traditional equipment = 傳統設備。相反。
obsolete systems = 過時系統。相反。

exercises.original: The showroom is updated every few months so customers can see new technology as soon as it reaches the market.
exercises.zh: 陳列室每幾個月更新一次，讓顧客看到一上市便出現的最新科技。
exercises.upgrade: latest technology · 最新科技；最新技術

options.explanation: advanced technology = 先進科技。未必是剛上市。
latest technology = 最新科技。as soon as it reaches the market 是決定性線索。
emerging technology = 新興科技。通常仍在發展，未必已上市。
traditional technology = 傳統科技。相反。
legacy systems = 舊系統。相反。
mature infrastructure = 成熟基建。無關。

exercises.original: The magazine reviews new technology that has just been released to consumers.
exercises.zh: 這本雜誌評測剛推出給消費者的最新科技。
exercises.upgrade: latest technology · 最新科技；最新技術

options.explanation: latest technology = 最新科技。has just been released 是最直接線索。
obsolete equipment = 過時設備。相反。
legacy technology = 舊技術。相反。
traditional devices = 傳統裝置。相反。
old systems = 舊系統。相反。
conventional machinery = 傳統機械。無關。

words.note: 當 new technology 的重點是創新的過程、方法或成果本身，而不是單純『新』，可用 technological innovation。它常見於商業、政策和研究語境。
words.example: Technological innovation is reshaping the transport industry.
words.exampleZh: 科技創新正在重塑運輸業。

exercises.original: The company's growth depends on new technology that creates better ways to manufacture products.
exercises.zh: 公司的增長依賴科技創新，以創造更好的生產方式。
exercises.upgrade: technological innovation · 科技創新；技術創新

options.explanation: technological innovation = 科技創新。creates better ways to manufacture 明確強調創新過程和新方法。
latest technology = 最新科技。只表示新近出現，不一定改善製造方法。
advanced technology = 先進科技。重點是水平高，不是創新行為。
legacy systems = 舊系統。相反。
traditional methods = 傳統方法。相反。
old equipment = 舊設備。相反。

exercises.original: Government grants are intended to encourage new technology in clean energy and manufacturing.
exercises.zh: 政府資助旨在鼓勵潔淨能源和製造業的科技創新。
exercises.upgrade: technological innovation · 科技創新；技術創新

options.explanation: modern innovations = 現代創新。可理解，但 encourage technological innovation 是政策語境中的固定自然搭配。
technological innovation = 科技創新。grants + encourage 是典型政策和研發語境。
latest technology = 最新科技。政府鼓勵的不是單純購買最新產品。
emerging technology = 新興科技。也可獲資助，但題目談廣泛創新。
legacy technology = 舊技術。相反。
traditional production = 傳統生產。相反。

exercises.original: The report argues that new technology is essential for improving productivity across the economy.
exercises.zh: 報告認為科技創新對提升整體經濟生產力非常重要。
exercises.upgrade: technological innovation · 科技創新；技術創新

options.explanation: technological innovation = 科技創新。improving productivity across the economy 是典型創新政策／經濟論述。
obsolete technology = 過時科技。通常降低效率。
legacy equipment = 舊設備。相反。
traditional methods = 傳統方法。不能表達創新推動生產力。
manual systems = 人工作業。無關。
old infrastructure = 舊基建。相反。

words.meaning: 下一代科技；新一代技術
words.note: 當 new technology 指正在取代現有一代產品或系統、代表下一輪技術世代的方案時，可用 next-generation technology。
words.example: The company is developing next-generation battery technology.
words.exampleZh: 公司正在開發下一代電池技術。

exercises.original: The company is developing new technology intended to replace today's battery design in future electric vehicles.
exercises.zh: 公司正開發下一代技術，計劃在未來電動車中取代現有電池設計。
exercises.upgrade: next-generation technology · 下一代科技；新一代技術

options.explanation: next-generation technology = 下一代科技。replace today's design + future vehicles 是明確的代際替換線索。
latest technology = 最新科技。可能已經上市，不一定是下一代。
mature technology = 成熟技術。通常已穩定，不是準備取代現有一代。
legacy technology = 舊式科技。相反。
conventional systems = 傳統系統。相反。
traditional equipment = 傳統設備。相反。

exercises.original: Engineers are testing new technology for the next generation of high-speed trains.
exercises.zh: 工程師正在測試下一代高速列車技術。
exercises.upgrade: next-generation technology · 下一代科技；新一代技術

options.explanation: advanced technology = 先進科技。可用，但 next generation 是更直接的世代線索。
next-generation technology = 下一代技術。和 next generation of trains 完全對應。
latest consumer technology = 最新消費科技。高速列車不是消費電子。
legacy technology = 舊技術。相反。
traditional systems = 傳統系統。相反。
obsolete equipment = 過時設備。相反。

exercises.original: The research program focuses on new technology that could power future aircraft more efficiently than current engines.
exercises.zh: 研究計劃聚焦下一代科技，希望比現有引擎更高效地為未來飛機提供動力。
exercises.upgrade: next-generation technology · 下一代科技；新一代技術

options.explanation: next-generation technology = 下一代科技。future aircraft + more efficient than current engines 明確表示要超越現有一代。
legacy systems = 舊式系統。相反。
traditional machinery = 傳統機械。相反。
obsolete technology = 過時科技。相反。
manual methods = 人工作法。無關。
mature systems only = 只限成熟系統。和研究未來技術不符。

words.note: 當 new technology 強調技術水平高、性能先進或比一般技術更精密時，可用 advanced technology。它不一定是最新，也不一定仍在發展中。
words.example: Advanced technology allows the system to process data much faster.
words.exampleZh: 先進科技讓系統能更快速處理數據。

exercises.original: The factory uses new technology that allows robots to inspect products with extremely high precision.
exercises.zh: 工廠使用先進科技，讓機械人能以極高精度檢查產品。
exercises.upgrade: advanced technology · 先進科技；高階技術

options.explanation: advanced technology = 先進科技。extremely high precision 表示技術水平高。
latest technology = 最新科技。題目沒有說剛推出。
emerging technology = 新興科技。沒有尚未成熟的線索。
traditional methods = 傳統方法。相反。
legacy equipment = 舊設備。相反。
manual inspection = 人工檢查。和 robots 相反。

exercises.original: The aircraft relies on new technology for navigation, communication, and flight control.
exercises.zh: 這架飛機依賴先進科技進行導航、通訊和飛行控制。
exercises.upgrade: advanced technology · 先進科技；高階技術

options.explanation: modern innovations = 現代創新。較泛，不如 advanced technology 突出航空系統的高技術水平。
advanced technology = 先進科技。navigation, communication, flight control 是精密高階系統。
emerging technology = 新興科技。飛機上的關鍵系統通常需成熟可靠。
obsolete technology = 過時科技。相反。
traditional systems = 傳統系統。不能表達高階技術。
manual controls only = 只有人手控制。和題目不符。

exercises.original: Modern hospitals depend on new technology for complex surgery and intensive monitoring.
exercises.zh: 現代醫院依賴先進科技進行複雜手術和密切監察。
exercises.upgrade: advanced technology · 先進科技；高階技術

options.explanation: advanced technology = 先進科技。complex surgery + intensive monitoring 要求高階、精密技術。
old equipment = 舊設備。相反。
legacy systems = 舊式系統。相反。
traditional tools = 傳統工具。不能表達現代複雜醫療。
manual methods = 人工作法。範圍和重點不符。
basic technology = 基礎技術。力度不足。

falseSynonyms.zh: 創新；創新成果不等於一般的 new technology innovation = 創新；創新成果 innovation 可以指新想法、方法或產品，但不一定是 technology。新商業模式也可以是 innovation。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Innovation may be technological, but not every innovation is technology.

falseSynonyms.zh: 發明；發明品不等於一般的 new technology invention = 發明；發明品 invention 指新創造出來的裝置、方法或概念。new technology 可以建立在多項既有發明之上，不等於單一發明。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON An invention may become part of a new technology.

falseSynonyms.zh: 科學不等於一般的 new technology science = 科學 science 是研究自然世界的知識與方法；technology 是把知識應用於工具、系統和實際用途。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Science discovers; technology applies knowledge.

falseSynonyms.zh: 小型電子裝置；小玩意不等於一般的 new technology gadget = 小型電子裝置；小玩意 gadget 通常指具體的小型裝置，範圍遠小於 new technology。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON A gadget may use new technology, but it is not the technology itself.

falseSynonyms.zh: 設備不等於一般的 new technology equipment = 設備 equipment 是實際使用的工具和機器；technology 還可包括軟件、方法、系統和技術原理。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Equipment can embody technology.

falseSynonyms.zh: 數碼的不等於一般的 new technology digital = 數碼的 digital 是形容詞，只表示以數碼形式運作；數碼系統未必是新的。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Digital technology can be old or new.
